cobblepartyhud.edit.title: Move and resize party HUD
cobblepartyhud.edit.help: Drag to move · Wheel: size · Arrows: fine-tune (Shift = 10)
cobblepartyhud.edit.empty_party: Your party is empty: the box shows where the party HUD will be.
cobblepartyhud.edit.disabled: Off: the party HUD is in Cobblemon's original place. Your layout is kept.
cobblepartyhud.edit.no_mixin: This Cobblemon version is not supported: the party HUD stays in its original place.
